claim: In the matching retail DLL, static MyMusic.Set (0x06002C23) has exact signature blob 00020111aa240e, two parameters (SYSTEM_SOUND bgm_mode, String fname), and an exact 44-byte body. Raw bgm_mode 33 stores fname into static Menu_SoundManager.MyMusic_SelectFile_Admission (0x04008705). Raw bgm_mode 34 stores fname into static Menu_SoundManager.MyMusic_SelectFile_Match (0x04008704). All other raw values reach the shared return without either store. FACT-0108 pins both already-canonical caller sites: IL+0x00C4 supplies raw 33 with System.String.Empty, and IL+0x00D7 supplies raw 33 with EditWrestlerData.ThemeMusic_Filename.
